text_block_list.name: Nefi-Nera
text_block_list.text:
Purgatory, Gio Gehenna—its myriad monsters differ wildly in both strength and flavor.
The meat of flame-clad beasts becomes fragrant depending on how it is seared.
As for poisonous monsters, with proper preparation their flesh yields medicinal effects.
text_block_list.orig_text:
煉獄、
ジオ・ゲヘナ──
種種様様の魔物らは、
強さも味も千差万別。
炎を纏う魔物の肉は
炙り加減で香ばしく。
毒持つ魔物の肉は
仕込み次第で薬効を得ますれば。

text_block_list.name: Nefi-Nera
text_block_list.text:
Now then, if all such meats were simmered together in a gently bubbling pot,
what manner of result would come to pass?
The secrets of Gio Gehenna–style hotpot—pray, behold the finished dish.
text_block_list.orig_text:
果て扨て、
掛かる肉らを諸共に、
コトコトぐつぐつ
鍋で煮込んだならば
如何なる仕儀になりましょうや？
ジオ・ゲヘナ流、
寄鍋の極意──
篤と仕上げを御覧じ給え。
